races.name: The Merriest Night
races.headline: A Night Full Of Holiday Magic
races.description: Choose from the 5K Run, Mile Walk/Run, and Daisy's Reindeer Run. Stick around for complimentary hot chocolate, food trucks, North Pole Main Street, crafts, ornaments, music, and holiday entertainment.

races.name: Hill For Gill
races.headline: Run for a Reason. Race for a Cause. Remember Jude.
races.location: Laurel Acres Park Mt. Laurel, NJ
races.description:
Join us for the Inaugural Hill for Gill Challenge, a community running event benefiting the Jude Gill Memorial Fund! Bring your friends, family, running partners, and community together for a morning of fitness, friendly competition, and a meaningful cause as we honor Jude’s memory and celebrate the impact one community can make when it comes together.
The Hill for Gill Challenge will be offering::
- 5K/10K Race
 - Kids Race(s)
- 1 Mile Family Fun Run/Walk.  
- VIRTUAL 5K and 10K Options!
